Edit target: our own first Nunu/Willump portrait. Supporting image: private original1999 HeroesIII portrait reference. Make ONE targeted correction to the faces' STYLE AND FORM; do not preserve their current smooth baby-doll eye/nose/cheek geometry. Repaint facial anatomy, materials and highlights decisively.

Render this as a photographed hand-painted 1990s fantasy miniature bust with a restrained oil-paint finishing pass. Strong sculpted three-dimensional planes, compact readable shapes and a practical single upper-left spotlight. The child must look like a REAL HUMAN BOY (about ten), not an animated movie or illustrated children's-book boy: naturally small eyes relative to the skull, a slightly longer believable nose bridge, broad matte forehead plane, unrounded lower eyelids, asymmetrical slight smile, some skin irregularity and simple cool shadows beneath brow and jaw. No enlarged sparkling eyes, glossy lips, round peach toy-cheeks or micro-decorative surface speckles. Keep the brown hair and red northern hood, youth and friendly expression.

Willump must look like a REAL heavy magical creature bust rather than a plush mascot: inset small gentle brown eyes under a substantial fur brow, broad squared blue muzzle with real structure, deep blue-gray shadow under cheekbones and muzzle, large matte rough blue nose with no glossy white highlight. Coarse dense fur CLUMPS with sparse economical painted highlights. Keep him kind and safe beside the child, not snarling. Preserve two curved brown horns and clear white brow tufts.

Composition remains the same paired head/shoulder identity: child on left, yeti on right, both heads complete and close, both sets of eyes at a similar middle level. Snowy mountains are subdued subordinate blue-gray scenery, some warm dawn at left, dark midtone behind white fur. No added props or characters. Do not copy original reference identities, panels, pixels or clothing. No pixel filter, arbitrary posterization, glittery brushwork, cartoon outlines, anime, Disney/Pixar aesthetics or modern glossy computer animation. One opaque square production portrait for native58x64/48x32.
